title.en: EVE Academy – How to Scan Cosmic Signatures

blocks.en: Exploration in EVE Online involves scanning down hidden locations
blocks.zh: EVE Online 中的探索，就是扫描出隐藏的地点，

blocks.en: to search for valuable loot hidden within them.
blocks.zh: 搜寻其中藏着的值钱战利品。

blocks.en: These sites may be ancient ruins where you uncover relics of the past
blocks.zh: 这些站点可能是古代遗迹，你可以在那里发掘往昔的遗物，

blocks.en: or hidden data vaults which you can hack into to retrieve the valuable information within.
blocks.zh: 也可能是隐藏的数据库，你可以入侵其中，获取有价值的信息。

blocks.en: To begin exploring, you will need a ship fit with the necessary equipment:
blocks.zh: 要开始探索，你需要一艘装配了必要装备的舰船：

blocks.en: A core scan probe launcher and 8 core scan probes.
blocks.zh: 一个核心探针发射器和 8 枚核心扫描探针。

blocks.en: You will also need a Relic Analyzer, a Data Analyzer, or both
blocks.zh: 你还需要遗迹分析仪、数据分析仪，或者两者都要，

blocks.en: depending on the type of site you are looking for.
blocks.zh: 具体取决于你要找的站点类型。

blocks.en: For this video, we'll fit both types of analyzers.
blocks.zh: 本视频中，我们两种分析仪都装上。

blocks.en: These modules can all be easily purchased via the in-game market.
blocks.zh: 这些装备都能在游戏内市场轻松买到。

blocks.en: While a Core Probe Launcher can be fit to any ship,
blocks.zh: 虽然核心探针发射器可以装在任何舰船上，

blocks.en: it helps to use a ship designed for exploration.
blocks.zh: 但使用专为探索设计的舰船会更有帮助。

blocks.en: These ships will have a bonus to scan probe strength, to make scanning easier,
blocks.zh: 这些舰船有扫描探针强度加成，让扫描更轻松，

blocks.en: as well as a bonus to relic and Data Analyzers.
blocks.zh: 还有遗迹分析仪和数据分析仪加成。

blocks.en: You can view the role bonuses of any ship by right clicking on it and choosing "show info".
blocks.zh: 右键点击任意舰船并选择「显示信息」，即可查看它的特有加成。

blocks.en: Each empire has its own entry-level frigate designed for exploration:
blocks.zh: 每个帝国都有自己的入门级探索护卫舰：

blocks.en: these are the Caldari Heron,
blocks.zh: 加达里的苍鹭级、

blocks.en: Gallente Imicus,
blocks.zh: 盖伦特的伊米卡斯级、

blocks.en: Amarr Magnate,
blocks.zh: 艾玛的富豪级，

blocks.en: and the aptly named Minmatar Probe.
blocks.zh: 以及名副其实的米玛塔尔探索级（Probe）。

blocks.en: Pick your favorite, fit it up, then undock and begin exploring.
blocks.zh: 挑一艘你喜欢的，装配好，然后离站开始探索。

blocks.en: Once you're out in space, it's time to start scanning.
blocks.zh: 到了太空中，就该开始扫描了。

blocks.en: Open the Probe Scanner window by clicking the "Scanners" button
blocks.zh: 点击电容左侧的「扫描器（Scanners）」按钮，

blocks.en: on the left hand side of your capacitor and then clicking the "Probe Scanner".
blocks.zh: 再点击「探针扫描器（Probe Scanner）」，打开探针扫描窗口。

blocks.en: This will open the probe scan window and the solar system map.
blocks.zh: 这会打开探针扫描窗口和星系地图。

blocks.en: In the probe scanner window we are looking for Cosmic Signatures.
blocks.zh: 在探针扫描窗口中，我们要找的是宇宙信号。

blocks.en: These are hidden sites which can only be located by scanning them down.
blocks.zh: 这些是隐藏的站点，只能通过扫描定位。

blocks.en: While exploring, you may find it helpful to use the filter in the probe scan window
blocks.zh: 探索时，你可以使用探针扫描窗口中的过滤器

blocks.en: to hide anomalies, which can already be warped to and show as entries in green.
blocks.zh: 隐藏异常——它们无需扫描就能直接跃迁，显示为绿色条目。

blocks.en: If there's a cosmic signature in your system, it's time to start scanning it down!
blocks.zh: 如果你的星系里有宇宙信号，就开始扫描吧！

blocks.en: Click the probe launcher module to the right of your capacitor to launch your probes
blocks.zh: 点击电容右侧的探针发射器装备发射探针，

blocks.en: you will see them appear on the solar system map.
blocks.zh: 你会看到它们出现在星系地图上。

blocks.en: Each blue sphere represents the scan range of your individual probes.
blocks.zh: 每个蓝色球体代表一枚探针的扫描范围。

blocks.en: Now, select the anomaly you would like to scan in the probe scan window
blocks.zh: 现在，在探针扫描窗口中选中你想扫描的信号，

blocks.en: and reposition your probes to be centered over it in the map.
blocks.zh: 然后在地图上移动探针，让它们以信号为中心。

blocks.en: You can move the probes by clicking and dragging the arrows
blocks.zh: 在星系地图中，点击并拖动中心立方体

blocks.en: around the sides of the center cube in the solar system map.
blocks.zh: 四周的箭头即可移动探针。

blocks.en: Remember that space is 3-dimensional, and you'll need to reposition your camera
blocks.zh: 记住，太空是三维的，你需要调整视角，

blocks.en: to make sure your probes are properly centered.
blocks.zh: 确保探针真正对准了中心。

blocks.en: You can quickly flip between the top and side view
blocks.zh: 为了方便操作，在地图空白处双击，

blocks.en: by double clicking on empty space in the map to make this easier.
blocks.zh: 可以在俯视图和侧视图之间快速切换。

blocks.en: Once your probes are centered, resize them using the slider
blocks.zh: 探针对准中心后，用探针扫描窗口底部的

blocks.en: at the bottom of the probe scan window to fully cover the cosmic signature.
blocks.zh: 滑块调整探针范围，完全覆盖住宇宙信号。

blocks.en: When the anomaly is surrounded by your probes,
blocks.zh: 当信号被探针包围后，

blocks.en: click the Analyze button in the probe scan window to scan it.
blocks.zh: 点击探针扫描窗口中的「分析（Analyze）」按钮进行扫描。

blocks.en: This will warp all of your probes into position and they will begin to scan.
blocks.zh: 所有探针会跃迁到位并开始扫描。

blocks.en: Once complete, you will notice that the anomaly shifts position and the signal will increase.
blocks.zh: 扫描完成后，你会发现信号的位置发生了变化，信号强度也提高了。

blocks.en: This represents your progress in narrowing down the location of the cosmic signature.
blocks.zh: 这表示你在逐步缩小宇宙信号所在的范围。

blocks.en: Now we repeat the process to continue scanning down the signature.
blocks.zh: 现在重复这个过程，继续扫描该信号。

blocks.en: Re-center your probes, checking the position both horizontally and vertically,
blocks.zh: 重新对准探针，同时检查水平和垂直方向的位置，

blocks.en: then reduce the size by one step and Analyze again.
blocks.zh: 然后把范围缩小一档，再次分析。

blocks.en: Keep doing this until the anomaly is scanned down:
blocks.zh: 一直重复，直到把信号扫出来：

blocks.en: Re-center, re-size, analyze.
blocks.zh: 对中、缩放、分析。

blocks.en: Once the cosmic signature has turned green you have successfully scanned down the site
blocks.zh: 当宇宙信号变成绿色时，你就成功扫出了这个站点，

blocks.en: and are now able to warp to it!
blocks.zh: 现在可以跃迁过去了！

blocks.en: Now that you have found the site, it's time to start breaking open those containers
blocks.zh: 找到站点后，就该用遗迹分析仪或数据分析仪

blocks.en: with your relic or data analyzer for the valuable loot within.
blocks.zh: 撬开那些容器，拿走里面的值钱战利品了。

blocks.en: We will cover this process in more detail in the Hacking for Profit video.
blocks.zh: 我们会在《破解赚钱》视频中更详细地介绍这个过程。
